tasks.prompt: Let n be a positive odd integer. Determine the parity of 3n+1 and prove it in one algebraic sentence.
Audit the claim: if a divides bc then a divides b or a divides c for all positive integers. Return VALID or INVALID and the smallest counterexample you can give.
State whether sqrt(2) is rational or irrational and give a compact contradiction proof outline without decimals.
A proof says: x^2=x implies divide both sides by x, so x=1; therefore x=0 is not a solution. Identify the exact invalid step.
Two reports use the same dataset, same base model, same prompt, and same derived lemma. Are they independent reproductions? Answer YES or NO and name the dependency.
Audit: all tested integers up to 10^12 satisfy property P, therefore every positive integer satisfies P. Identify the inference error.
